es.title: SUBTRACK
es.desc: App self-hosted para controlar suscripciones: gasto mensual y anual, próximos cobros y gasto por categoría. Spring Boot + React/TypeScript + PostgreSQL en una sola imagen Docker.
es.learned: Qué hice: la app entera, de la API con Spring Boot y PostgreSQL al frontend con React. Aprendí a testear con Testcontainers y a empaquetarlo todo en una sola imagen Docker.

en.title: SUBTRACK
en.desc: Self-hosted app to keep track of subscriptions: monthly and yearly spend, upcoming charges and spend by category. Spring Boot + React/TypeScript + PostgreSQL in a single Docker image.
en.learned: What I did: the whole app, from the Spring Boot + PostgreSQL API to the React frontend. I learned to test with Testcontainers and to ship everything as a single Docker image.

media.es: Panel de subtrack en modo oscuro con el gasto mensual, los próximos cobros y el gasto por categoría
media.en: subtrack dashboard in dark mode with monthly spend, upcoming charges and spend by category

es.title: TABMON
es.desc: Convierte una tablet Android en un monitor extendido para niri por USB, usando una pantalla virtual (vkms) y wayvnc. Publicado en AUR.
es.learned: Qué hice: una CLI en Rust que resuelve un límite real de niri. Aprendí a trabajar con módulos del kernel (vkms), procesos externos y a publicar un paquete en AUR.

en.title: TABMON
en.desc: Turns an Android tablet into an extended monitor for niri over USB, using a virtual display (vkms) and wayvnc. Published on the AUR.
en.learned: What I did: a Rust CLI that works around a real niri limitation. I learned to work with kernel modules (vkms), external processes and to publish a package on the AUR.

media.text:
$ tabmon doctor
✓ niri installed
✓ wayvnc installed
✓ adb installed
✓ vkms module loaded
✓ output Virtual-1 exists in niri
✓ adb device ready

es.title: CI/CD DAW
es.desc: Pipeline de CI/CD con GitHub Actions: en cada push construye la imagen Docker, la sube a Docker Hub y la despliega por SSH en una instancia de AWS EC2.
es.learned: Aprendí a encadenar integración y despliegue continuos, a gestionar secretos en GitHub y a desplegar sin tocar el servidor a mano.

en.title: CI/CD DAW
en.desc: CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions: on every push it builds the Docker image, pushes it to Docker Hub and deploys it over SSH to an AWS EC2 instance.
en.learned: I learned to chain continuous integration and delivery, manage secrets on GitHub and deploy without touching the server by hand.

media.text:
jobs:
  build-and-push:
    steps:
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
  deploy:
    needs: build-and-push
    steps:
      - uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
